scope: One 192x192 synthetic host-Mesa RTV4 black-stroke control; analytical precomposed RGBA PNG on opaque white, compared against source-over composition inferred from the native transparent alpha capture.
limitations: Resolution-specific raster, not scalable vector paint; model must be recomputed for each output resolution and device coordinate context.
White paper comparison is calculated from transparent native output, not a separately captured native white framebuffer.
One scale, black stroke and host control only; no generic-path comparison, arbitrary color, saved-note, Android, or production parity.
Dependent on retained temporary source evidence and the shared target runner described in pencil2-v14-svg-pdf-control.json.
independent_reproduction: Resvg, MuPDF 1.28.2 and pypdfium2 4.30.0 reproduced all reported metrics.
